options.name: fail_msg
options.description: The customized message used for a failing assertion. This argument was called O(msg) before Ansible 2.7, now it is renamed to O(fail_msg) with alias O(msg).

options.name: quiet
options.description: Set this to V(true) to avoid verbose output.

options.name: success_msg
options.description: The customized message used for a successful assertion.

options.name: that
options.description: A list of string expressions of the same form that can be passed to the C(when) statement.
